title: Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: A new field report shows how scientists use AI coding agents to modernize scientific computing, accelerating software development and discovery in genomics and beyond.
body: A new field report outlines how scientific computing is being transformed by agentic AI workflows. By automating software development, code translation, and data parsing, coding agents allow researchers to focus on hypothesis generation and discovery. The integration of agents into bioinformatics and physical sciences is significantly reducing the time required to develop custom analysis pipelines. This report emphasizes that the role of coding assistants is shifting from simple autocompletion to executing complex, multi-step scientific simulations. It provides valuable insights for laboratories adopting agentic tools.
